_doc: The end credits after the funeral (see Credits). Cards in turn, each a few seconds: 'lines' are [style, text], styles role (the small line over a name), name, film, line, end, and gap (a space between two credits sharing a card); 'title' draws the title card's art; 'for' is how long it stays (seconds, besides the fades). The last card is the ending's: 'ends'.
